What this section does not claim

  • Nothing is claimed beyond this demo artifact and its frozen probe set.
  • The A-to-B delta measures only policy-B probability on frozen disagreement probes.
  • Unit-test doubles check the orchestration only; demo readiness requires a real Khive replay that satisfies the measured direction gate.
